subject: Bouncey, Bouncey
author: Xandu
body:
This was fun to watch and record.  😃

As all of you probably have understood this is not actual gameplay. Here is how we set it up.

1. Stream the Burnout CRASH! gameplay video from youtube on our Samsung Smart TV
2. Place 1 Zombietron in front of Kinect sensor.
3. Place one Canon EOS 500d on tripod behind Zombietron
4. Place one Xandu behind camera
5. Record and then edit in Windows Movie Maker
6. Upload to youtube

-- The Creator --
